execution: Black-box acceptance scenarios for a candidate tool. The repository release check validates scenario completeness, not runtime outcomes.

scenarios.initial: The example collection has index 2. Two clients read generation 0.
actions: Client A reserves child 0003 at generation 0 and commits.
Client B attempts the same allocation using generation 0.
Client B refreshes and reserves the next child.
expected: A commits generation 1 with index 3, child 0003 and its reference record.
B receives a conflict without changing any file.
B commits generation 2 with index 4 and child 0004. IDs are unique.

scenarios.initial: The valid example snapshot is generation 0.
actions: Begin a document move and its _refs path update.
Interrupt after each individual persistent write, in separate runs.
Restart; request a snapshot and then a new mutation.
expected: Each recovered snapshot equals either the complete old state or the complete intended new state.
Every recovered snapshot passes C01-C08; no reader sees a torn path/index pair.
Recovery completes before accepting the next mutation.

scenarios.initial: The example decision has incoming depends-on and body links.
actions: Request deletion of the decision.
Request deletion of its enclosing notional folder.
expected: Both operations are rejected with references identifying the blockers.
Source files, index and generation remain unchanged.

scenarios.initial: Remove the body link from the example source, set depends-on on-delete to detach and rebuild its valid index.
actions: Delete the target decision.
Read the project snapshot.
expected: The source's forward edge and target document are removed in one commit.
The target index record is gone, remaining records match the derived graph.
The resulting snapshot passes C01-C08.

scenarios.initial: Move a document outside the tool, leaving its index path stale.
actions: Validate/scan without requesting repair.
Approve and apply the proposed repair with the observed generation.
Apply the same now-stale proposal again.
expected: The first operation reports C08 and changes no bytes.
Repair updates the index to the actual path without changing the document GUID.
The repeated stale proposal conflicts and changes no bytes.

scenarios.initial: Two authored documents declare the same GUID.
actions: Scan with repair requested.
expected: Report C06 and stop repair.
Do not mint replacement GUIDs, delete files or select one copy as authoritative.

scenarios.initial: Each valid document from the preservation fixture list.
actions: Read the document using the candidate tool.
Serialize without edits.
expected: Output bytes equal input bytes, including YAML comments, quoting, hard-break spaces, list start values, fences and unknown HTML.

actions: Read with a candidate interactive reader.
Inspect diagnostics and any displayed versions property.
Serialize without an edit.
expected: Report C04; parsing does not delete or merge blocks.
If a fallback property is displayed it is the first valid marked block.
The original two blocks remain byte-identical in the serialization.

actions: Replace only the title text using the candidate editor.
Serialize and parse the resulting document.
expected: Only the heading's text bytes change; hard-break spaces, list start values and unrelated metadata remain identical.
The edited snapshot passes the document rules.
